context: Tests whether the agent applies the release skill's specific conventions for addressing review feedback: fixing all CI failures without exception, applying reasonable suggestions, pushing back on over-engineered suggestions, using the exact reply formats for accepted and declined threads, ensuring no thread is left without a reply, and pushing fixes to the same branch.

checklist.name: CI failure: fix required
checklist.description: For the CI failure (failing unit test), the guide states the test must be fixed — does NOT suggest ignoring it, skipping it, or deferring it

checklist.name: Accepted reply format
checklist.description: For the accepted suggestion, the reply text follows the format `Fixed in <sha>` — uses this exact phrasing (not 'Done', 'Resolved', 'Applied', or similar alternatives)

checklist.name: Declined reply format
checklist.description: For the declined/over-engineered suggestion, the reply text follows the format `Declining — <reason>` — uses this exact phrasing with the em dash

checklist.name: All threads replied
checklist.description: The guide covers a reply for ALL three feedback threads (CI failure thread, accepted suggestion thread, declined suggestion thread) — no thread is left without a response

checklist.name: Push to same branch
checklist.description: States that any code fixes should be pushed to the same existing branch — NOT to a new branch

checklist.name: Apply reasonable suggestion
checklist.description: For the clearly correct suggestion (simplifying the conditional), the guide says to apply/implement it — does NOT suggest declining it or skipping it

checklist.name: Decline over-engineered suggestion
checklist.description: For the over-engineered suggestion (unnecessary abstraction), the guide says to push back or decline it with a reason — does NOT say to blindly implement it

checklist.name: No dangling threads
checklist.description: The guide explicitly states or implies that every thread must have a reply before the PR can be merged — does NOT leave any thread unaddressed
